what: Inside a one-line window under the card, on hover the whole tag row slides up 20px and turns off (each tag following .05s later), and in its place the ”View work” words rise from 18px below at .05s and .1s intervals and turn on, .46s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1). On release it plays in reverse.

options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Duration and curve (via style), default .46s · cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)
options.--fx-each: Delay between words (via style), default .05s — 0s means all at once
options.--fx-drop · --fx-rise: Distance the tag row slides out · distance new words rise (via style), default 20px · 18px
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Single-row window (required) — stack out and in inside it
options.[data-fx-part=out]: Default visible line (tag) — one turn per child
options.[data-fx-part=in]: Words that rise on hover — staggered per child (word)

from.where: index.css .dt-card__cap footer — on original card :hover, ul opacity 0·−20px, each li delayed by .05s to −20px, p opacity 1·−18px, p span 18px→0 (.05s·.1s)

note: Not applied on touch screens (pointer: coarse) — only the tag row shows, like the original
